description: Block-transition census and the goto_ptr lookup cache (patches/0009), September 13, 2026, leviathan, Chromium 151. census: per-workload counts of every transition kind from an instrumented engine (WASM32_CENSUS). ab: exec-bench runs for warm128 (the release engine as served), base (fork8 rebuilt in the investigation's container; wasm identical to the release) and jc (the cache), cores 28-31 then 84-87; the first set's control overlapped a game server. emu: emubench medians. prof: perf attribution of the vCPU thread by mechanism, release engine and cache engine.
